title: Time-Off Tracker
description: Small teams and HR: request and approve leave, with a team calendar and balances.

spec.useCase: Camille Girard manages a dental clinic of eight and uses this to approve leave, see who is away and keep every allowance straight.

business.name: Willowbrook Dental
business.describes: A dental clinic with eight staff that needs two hygienists and a dentist every working day.

tables.name: Balances
tables.describes: Each person's yearly allowance, days carried over and days used so far.
tables.subject: thing

fields.label: Balance check
fields.formula: IF({Vacation days left} <= 3, "Low", IF({Vacation days left} < 0, "Over", "Fine"))

fields.label: Used (%)
fields.formula: IF({Total available} > 0, ROUND({Vacation days used} / {Total available} * 100, 0), 0)

text.text: Ask for time off, see who is away and keep every allowance honest. Use the form to request days, then approve or decline from Pending approvals.

Balances
These numbers update as you work. Use this page for the weekly check, then open the list behind any number to act on it.
Days used by person
Recent sickness
How to read this page
Each chart groups your entries as shown; click a slice to see the entries behind it.
The lists below show only what needs attention now.
If a chart looks off, check that every entry is connected to the right person or item.
The short version of how leave works. Ask the operations manager for anything not covered here.
Vacation
Ask at least two weeks ahead for more than three days.
The clinic needs two hygienists and one dentist on every working day.
Up to five unused days carry over until the end of March.
Sick leave
Tell the front desk before the start of your shift.
A note is needed after three days in a row.
Parental and unpaid leave
Parental leave is paid for the first eight weeks.
Unpaid leave needs the manager and the owner to agree.
Half days count as 0.5. Enter whole working days between start and end; weekends do not count.
Worked example
An employee with 20 days allowance and 3 carried over has 23 available. After 9 vacation days, 14 remain. The Balance check column flags anyone at 3 days or fewer so managers can plan cover.
Request steps
Employee submits a request with dates and cover.
Manager reviews within two working days and presses Approve or Decline.
The balance updates from approved vacation days only.
List company closures and public holidays here so requests do not collide with them.
Days the clinic is closed. These never count against anyone's allowance.
